{{Top|leg}}
'''RAM''' was part of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid's]] systems. It stored [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump coordinates in its RAM.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
